lines.t: Chasing after money, running fast, feeling hollow
Keeping up with the Joneses every day, another battle
Obligations stacking up, the world expects me to follow
My soul's tied, is there hope for tomorrow?
This rat race, this chase for shiny things
Jealousy creeps in, envy and greed
The more I climb, the more I bleed
I reach for fruit that never feeds
But true peace ain't bought, it's received
What's the value of wealth if I lose myself in my need?
Let go of what the world's been selling
Peace comes in surrender when the heart stops pretending
Burdens get heavy, hope starts bending
But love calls out, forgiveness is never ending
Glory fades and status falls
Only love remains when trouble calls
Real strength's in a heart that trusts
Faith lifts me when I'm torn and crushed
So I push on, finish the race
Rise above pride, in mercy I'm grace
If every road leads back to doubt
If every master's hiding pain
There's a voice that whispers, I am the way, walk with me
Only one truth, only one life
Be free
It ain't about what they approve
It's who I choose with every move
That's the answer, not the crowds
Choose freedom, choose to lose the shroud
Every loss is found in love
Every pain healed from above
So I choose to come home
Leave the grind to be known
All these years, keeping up
Lost sight of what's real
Now I'm running to the arms
Where all wounds can heal
Letting go and receiving
Love that never fades
No more chasing the wind
I'm coming home
Unafraid
Bye.
